steps.en: Company notices that need follow-up are picked automatically
steps.id: Notice company yang perlu follow-up dipilih otomatis
steps.why_en: Only notices due at a reminder stage are picked, not every company daily.
steps.why_id: Hanya notice yang jatuh tempo di stage reminder yang dipilih, bukan semua company tiap hari.

steps.en: The update runs automatically every day
steps.why_en: The daily job is switched off in the live environment; it also skips Sundays and holidays.
steps.why_id: Job harian dimatikan di lingkungan live; Minggu dan hari libur juga dilewati.

steps.en: Company registration numbers are sent to the registry
steps.id: Nomor registrasi company dikirim ke registry
steps.why_en: Sending is built, but the live view names are unverified and the job is off.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman sudah dibuat, tetapi nama view live belum diverifikasi dan job mati.

steps.en: The latest company name and address come back from the registry
steps.id: Nama dan alamat company terbaru kembali dari registry

steps.en: The company name on the notice is replaced with the new one
steps.id: Nama company di notice diganti dengan yang baru

steps.en: The company address on the notice is replaced with the new one
steps.id: Alamat company di notice diganti dengan yang baru
